A '''non-commissioned officer''', or '''non-com''' for short, was a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had not yet been given a commission. Non-commissioned officers were also referred to as '''NCOs'''.<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>

==History==
Noncoms existed in various armies.

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], while [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|was after]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces under [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] moved against him. A ranking noncom led a band of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], most of them gathered from [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and were a bit intoxicated; the noncom pointed out that Katarn had a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on his head, and would make them rich. Hearing his voice, Katarn noted that he talked to his underlings as if they were in a ground parade.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
